subject: Rent shows unpaid
body: I paid on the 1st through the portal but my account still shows a balance. Confirmation number 88213.
resolution: Payment PM-9834 located and posted manually. Balance corrected to $0.00.

subject: Water leaking under kitchen sink
body: There is water pooling under the kitchen sink and the cabinet is getting soaked.
resolution: Emergency work order WO-86110 dispatched same night. Supply line replaced.

subject: Question about late fee
body: I paid on the 4th. Why was I charged a late fee?
resolution: Explained grace period ends end of day on the 3rd. Fee upheld, lease section 4.2 cited.

subject: Lease renewal options
body: My lease ends in October, what are my options?
resolution: Sent renewal offer with 12-month and month-to-month rates. Resident to respond in portal.

subject: Dog approval
body: We are adopting a beagle, about 25 pounds. What do we need to do?
resolution: Sent pet addendum. $300 fee plus $25/month pet rent. Breed and weight within limits.

subject: AC not cooling
body: Thermostat set to 70 but the apartment is 84 degrees.
resolution: Work order WO-86620 created, dispatched next morning. Capacitor replaced.

subject: Deposit refund
body: I moved out June 30 and have not received my deposit.
resolution: Refund of $312.50 mailed July 24 with itemized deductions for carpet cleaning.

subject: Neighbor noise
body: The unit above me has people up until 2am every night this week.
resolution: Courtesy notice sent to unit above. Resident advised to log further incidents.

subject: Add roommate to lease
body: My partner is moving in September 1, what is the process?
resolution: Application and screening required, then lease amendment. Application link sent.

subject: Charge I do not recognize
body: There is a $12 pest control charge on my statement that I never agreed to.
resolution: Community-wide service under lease section 7. Billing inquiry B-4410 opened for review.

subject: Locked out
body: I am locked out of my apartment and it is after hours.
resolution: After-hours lockout service dispatched. $75 lockout fee applied to account.

subject: Parking space taken
body: Someone keeps parking in space 22 which is assigned to my unit.
resolution: Vehicle tagged for tow warning. Resident advised to report repeats to the office.
